user.title: Sources and limits
user.description: Map the feeds of the Open Concept wiring plan: shore power before V2L (primary bus), primary bus before solar generator (comfort bus). Fixed loads are never switched; only loads marked “only with headroom” are paused when the source cannot carry them.

data_description.landstrom_entity: If you only have a voltage, create a threshold helper first.
data_description.limit_v2l_w: Continuous V2L output per vehicle data.
data_description.limit_generator_w: Per datasheet, e.g. 3,600 W for the FOSSiBOT F3600 Pro.
data_description.release_margin_w: Headroom kept free before a load “only with headroom” is released.
data_description.release_delay_off_s: Time a headroom load may run without release before it is paused.
data_description.release_delay_on_s: Time the release must be stable before a paused load is switched on again.

data_description.flexible: Released only while the feeding source can carry it in addition; paused otherwise. Leave off for loads that must never be switched.
